title: Coding Agent Effort (private)

list.name: Adopted fixes
list.rawQuery:
SELECT adopted_at AS time, title AS text, kind || ',' || array_to_string(rubric_ids, ',') AS tags
FROM agents.improve_adoption WHERE $__timeFilter(adopted_at) ORDER BY 1;

target.rawSql:
SELECT adopted_at AS time, title AS text, kind || ',' || array_to_string(rubric_ids, ',') AS tags
FROM agents.improve_adoption WHERE $__timeFilter(adopted_at) ORDER BY 1;

description: Private: effort, outcomes, cost, coverage and the counting audit from the phase 5 views. Keep it on a private network; hours never leave this dashboard.

panels.title: Steers, commits and sessions per day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamp AS time, steers, commits, interactive_sessions
FROM agents.effort_daily
WHERE day >= $__timeFrom()::date AND day <= $__timeTo()::date
ORDER BY 1;

panels.description: Human steers outside scripted runs, distinct commits (superseded pre-amend SHAs left out) and interactive sessions, per local day. agents.effort_daily, refreshed nightly.

panels.title: Active minutes per day (private)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamp AS time, active_minutes_all, active_minutes_relevant
FROM agents.effort_daily
WHERE day >= $__timeFrom()::date AND day <= $__timeTo()::date
ORDER BY 1;

panels.description: Merged active time (steer islands, ActivityWatch, manual), all and work-relevant. Private number: never published.

panels.title: Weekly effort

targets.rawSql:
SELECT week, steers, interactive_sessions, projects, commits, merged_commits, prs,
       episodes_active, episodes_started, focus_blocks, parallel_peak,
       round(active_minutes_relevant / 60, 1) AS relevant_hours
FROM agents.effort_weekly
WHERE week >= $__timeFrom()::date - 6 AND week <= $__timeTo()::date
ORDER BY week DESC;

panels.description: Per ISO week. Sessions, projects, commits and episodes are counted once per week. Episodes exclude rejected ones and ones labelled non-building (learning, collaboration, other). Focus blocks: 60+ minute stretches mostly steering or editor/dev/terminal time. Parallel peak: most interactive sessions steered in one 15-minute window.

panels.title: Episode outcomes per month

targets.rawSql:
SELECT month, episodes, shipped, reworked, open, ruled_out, no_code, undecided,
       shipped_share, rework_share, final
FROM agents.outcomes_monthly
ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12;

panels.description: Counted episodes (no reject, building work only) by the month they started. episode_monthly counts every linked episode, so its numbers are higher; Phase 6 publishes these final months. final = complete the way episode_monthly publishes it; before that the counts can still move.

panels.title: Shipping and rework per month
panels.description: Commits by the month they were first seen, by their latest git outcome. Reverted = reverted within 14 days of the merge; reworked = under half the lines survive 14 days.

panels.title: Work mix per month
panels.description: Phase 4 work_category labels. unit_share = share of labelled units among confident labels, not of active minutes: an episode day and an ActivityWatch block each count once. unknown = below the label's threshold. Empty until labels exist.

panels.title: Efficiency per month (notional cost)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT month, shipped, episodes, median_tokens_shipped, round(median_cost_usd_shipped::numeric, 2) AS median_cost_usd_shipped,
       tokens_per_shipped, cost_usd_per_shipped
FROM agents.efficiency_by_episode
ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12;

panels.description: Tokens and API-equivalent cost of counted episodes. Cost estimates require price coverage for the episodes included in each measure.

panels.title: Cost per day by model (notional)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamp AS time, model AS metric, CASE WHEN sum(unpriced_turns) = 0 THEN sum(est_cost_usd) END AS cost
FROM agents.tokens_cost_by_model_daily
WHERE day >= $__timeFrom()::date AND day <= $__timeTo()::date
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.description: API-equivalent USD per local day and model. A day with unpriced usage shows no estimate.

panels.title: Interrupts and rejections per month

targets.rawSql:
SELECT month, cases, interrupts, rejections, before_tool_errors_avg, after_tool_errors_avg,
       before_retries, after_retries, before_runaways, after_runaways, before_commits, after_commits
FROM agents.intervention_monthly
ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12;

panels.description: Interrupts and rejections followed by a steer: the interrupted turn against the turn after the steer (tool errors, retry and runaway flags, commits).

panels.title: Coverage: days each source reported

targets.rawSql:
SELECT month,
       max(days) FILTER (WHERE source = 'agents') AS agents,
       max(days) FILTER (WHERE source = 'activitywatch') AS activitywatch,
       max(days) FILTER (WHERE source = 'outcomes') AS outcomes,
       max(days) FILTER (WHERE source = 'labels') AS labels
FROM agents.coverage_monthly
GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12;

panels.description: Local days per month with data from each source. An empty cell: that source never reported in the month.

panels.title: Counting audit, last 14 days

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day, raw_usage_rows, dedup_usage_rows, dup_groups, dup_unexplained, activity_ts_conflicts,
       scripted_share, stale_collectors, links_without_session, overlap_share
FROM agents.audit_daily
WHERE day > current_date - 14
ORDER BY day DESC;

panels.description: dup_unexplained = usage events stored twice that the Claude Code re-log rule does not explain; a monitoring check should alert on it. overlap_share = share of per-source active minutes that overlap another source.

panels.title: Developer intent estimates

targets.rawSql: SELECT month, label, units AS sampled_units, estimated_units, estimated_share, unknown_share, quality FROM agents.working_label_monthly WHERE task = 'steer_intent' ORDER BY month DESC, estimated_units DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.description: Provisional Sonnet primary categories, sampling-weighted from the frozen historical baseline. Estimates, not verified facts or hours. Unknown cases remain in the denominator.

panels.title: Agent outcome estimates

targets.rawSql: SELECT month, label, units AS sampled_units, estimated_units, estimated_share, unknown_share, quality FROM agents.working_label_monthly WHERE task = 'soft_outcome' ORDER BY month DESC, estimated_units DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.description: Provisional Sonnet outcome categories from the frozen historical baseline. Estimates of sampled work units, separate from measured git and episode outcomes. Unknown cases remain visible.

panels.title: Reviewed signal estimates

targets.rawSql: SELECT month, question, answer, units, review_source, quality FROM agents.working_signal_monthly ORDER BY month DESC, question, answer LIMIT 200;

panels.description: Provisional direct agent-review counts only. Yes, no, uncertain (unknown), and not reviewed remain separate. This deliberately selected subset does not estimate population prevalence. These are not human-verified labels.

panels.title: Fail rate by rubric, weekly
panels.description: Model estimates from sampled cases, not a prevalence estimate. (unqualified) means fewer than 20 human-labelled fails or agreement below the rubric bar. Adoption markers show when a fix was adopted, not that it caused a change. Harnesses and triggers are separate series.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', day)::timestamp AS time,
       rubric_id || ' v' || rubric_version || ' ' || harness || ' control' || CASE WHEN bool_and(qualified) THEN '' ELSE ' (unqualified)' END AS metric,
       sum(failed)::float / NULLIF(sum(passed + failed), 0) AS value
FROM agents.improve_score_latest
WHERE trigger = 'control' AND day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
GROUP BY 1, rubric_id, rubric_version, harness ORDER BY 1;

SELECT date_trunc('week', day)::timestamp AS time,
       rubric_id || ' v' || rubric_version || ' ' || harness || ' error_result' || CASE WHEN bool_and(qualified) THEN '' ELSE ' (unqualified)' END AS metric,
       sum(failed)::float / NULLIF(sum(passed + failed), 0) AS value
FROM agents.improve_score_latest
WHERE trigger = 'error_result' AND day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
GROUP BY 1, rubric_id, rubric_version, harness ORDER BY 1;

SELECT date_trunc('week', day)::timestamp AS time,
       rubric_id || ' v' || rubric_version || ' ' || harness || ' merge' || CASE WHEN bool_and(qualified) THEN '' ELSE ' (unqualified)' END AS metric,
       sum(failed)::float / NULLIF(sum(passed + failed), 0) AS value
FROM agents.improve_score_latest
WHERE trigger = 'merge' AND day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
GROUP BY 1, rubric_id, rubric_version, harness ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Judged cases and unknown share, weekly
panels.description: Model estimates from sampled cases, not a prevalence estimate. (unqualified) means fewer than 20 human-labelled fails or agreement below the rubric bar. Adoption markers show when a fix was adopted, not that it caused a change. Harnesses and triggers are separate series.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', day)::timestamp AS time, rubric_id || ' v' || rubric_version || ' ' || harness || ' ' || trigger || ' judged' AS metric, sum(passed+failed+unknown) AS value
FROM agents.improve_score_latest
WHERE day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
GROUP BY 1, rubric_id, rubric_version, harness, trigger ORDER BY 1;

SELECT date_trunc('week', day)::timestamp AS time, rubric_id || ' v' || rubric_version || ' ' || harness || ' ' || trigger || ' unknown share' AS metric, sum(unknown)::float / NULLIF(sum(passed+failed+unknown), 0) AS value
FROM agents.improve_score_latest
WHERE day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
GROUP BY 1, rubric_id, rubric_version, harness, trigger ORDER BY 1;
